thread:
alex: hi all, Alex here (eng-platform) — mapping who to ping for demo perms this week: VPC subnet, registry push, Datadog access, feature-flag toggle. demo is Thurs; want the fastest path so I don’t ping the wrong teams.
jamie (People Ops): welcome @alex! :tada: People Ops keeps the owner matrix and ill DM the link. mark requests with "demo-priority" and cc your manager for faster routing.
reza (infra): infra owns VPC/subnet/network ACLs. Open a #help ticket with subject: `vpc-demo: <name>` and include github handle, requested cidr, purpose and expiry. tag @infra-oncall to expedite. ETA ~24h for simple adds.
mia (platform): platform owns registry pushes and deploy roles for Dedicated. DM me your GitHub handle + repo/image and i can issue a short-lived deploy key until org invite completes. for model pinning see https://kb.redwood.ai/dedicated-pin.
oliver (observability): observability owns Datadog/APM and dashboard access. File an access request and include dashboard ids and whether you need edit vs view. for demos we can grant temp edit access for the day.
zara (security): security manages Vault tokens, long-lived creds and rotation policies. For demos we can issue expiring Vault tokens; ticket must include purpose, TTL and manager approval.
alex: thanks — can someone paste minimal ticket snippets I can copy/paste?
reza (infra): VPC ticket snippet:
```
Subject: vpc-demo: alex
- Github: alexGH
- Requested subnet: 10.50.12.0/24
- Buckets needed: s3://redwood-demo, s3://redwood-artifacts
- Purpose: internal demo Thurs 2026-04-02
- Expiry: 2026-04-03
- Manager: Priya (eng-platform)
```
mia (platform): Registry/deploy snippet:
```
Subject: registry-demo: alex
- Github: alexGH
- Repo/image: github.com/redwood/demo -> registry.redwood.ai/demo:pr-7
- Role: model-deployer (short-lived)
- Expiry: 2026-04-03 EOD
- Manager: Priya (eng-platform)
```
oliver (observability): Datadog snippet:
```
Subject: datadog-access: alex
- Dashboards: dd/dashboard/1234, dd/dashboard/5678
- Access: edit (demo day only)
- Expiry: 2026-04-03
- Manager: Priya (eng-platform)
```
zara (security): Vault token snippet:
```
Subject: vault-token-demo: alex
- Resource: vault/data/demo-keys
- TTL: 8h (demo day)
- Purpose: demo telemetry + s3 reads
- Manager: Priya (eng-platform)
```
onboard-bot: queued request (id:onb-2201234578). you will get updates here.
alex: filing these now, DMing @mia my GH handle. will page infra-oncall if anything blocks the demo. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
